title: Check-up for a chronic cough
what: The doctor looks for the cause of a cough that has not gone away for several weeks. For this they ask questions, examine you, and do a few tests.
why: If a cough lasts longer than 3 to 8 weeks in an adult or longer than 4 weeks in a child, especially with phlegm, shortness of breath, or blood.
duration: the first visit usually takes 20 to 40 minutes; the tests take from a few days to a couple of weeks
tell_doctor: How long the cough has lasted and when it is worse, day or night
Whether there is phlegm, what color, and whether there was blood
Whether you smoke now or smoked before
Which medicines you take, since some blood pressure pills cause a cough
Whether you were in contact with someone with tuberculosis

prepare.title: Cough diary
prepare.text: Write down when the cough is worse and what triggers it: food, cold, lying down, dust.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Tell your doctor everything you take.

prepare.title: Past pictures
prepare.text: Bring your lung X-ray or CT, if you had one.

steps: The doctor asks in detail about the cough
Listens to your lungs and looks at your throat and nose
Usually sends you for a chest X-ray
May order a breathing test called spirometry
Sometimes a phlegm or blood test is needed
Based on the results, prescribes treatment or refers you to the right doctor
feel: For spirometry you have to blow out hard, and you may feel dizzy
after: Treatment depends on the cause, and there are several
Sometimes treatment is tried first to see if the cough goes away
The follow-up visit is after the time your doctor sets
red_flags: Coughing up blood, severe shortness of breath, or chest pain: see a doctor urgently or call emergency services
A high fever and hard breathing: call emergency services

faq.q: How long can a cough last after a cold?
faq.a: Sometimes up to 3 to 8 weeks. If it lasts longer or gets worse, see a doctor.

faq.q: Is a chest X-ray always needed?
faq.a: Most often yes, it is one of the first tests. Your doctor decides.

reminders.text: Cough appointment tomorrow. Bring your lung images and list of medicines.
